body:
The seventeenth chapter turns to those still standing in lower śāstras — Vaiṣṇavas and the rest, down to the lower tantric ends — or vow-holders, or even people in the supreme śāstra who lack authority and serve lower teachers. When descent turns them, this is their course. Lodge them first. Another day: hear their conduct, bring them before the Lord who has been commonly worshipped. Take their vow, cast them in water, bathe them, sprinkle, refine with tooth-stick and rice-cake, blindfold, bring them in. Make Lord-worship by a common mantra. Then by that mantra, Śiva-made fire: vow-purity — a hundred "I purify" offerings, svāhā. Then a full offering, vauṣaḍa-ended. Then summon the vow-lord, worship him, by his command declare "you are ineffective for him," satiate him, dismiss the fire: liṅgoddhāra. Then lodging and the rest as before. Initiation as you wish.

The passage moves in six steps. (1) Eligibility: lower-śāstra dwellers (Vaiṣṇava etc.) and even supreme-śāstra-standing-without-authority serving lower teachers, when turned by descent, get this course. (2) Lodging done, another day: common-mantra-worshipped, conduct heard, brought before Lord; vow taken, cast in water, bathed, sprinkled, refined with tooth-stick and cake, bound-eyed, brought in; Lord-worship by common mantra. (3) By common mantra, Śiva-made fire: vow-purity — a hundred "I purify," svāhā. (4) Full offering, vauṣaḍa-ended. (5) Vow-lord summoned, worshipped, "ineffective you be for him" declared, satiated, fire dismissed = liṅgoddhāra. (6) Lodging etc. as before; initiation as wished.
terms: liṅgoddhāra (liṅga-lifting), adharāśāsanastha (lower-śāstra dweller), sādhāraṇamantra (common mantra), vrataśuddhi (vow-purity), akiṃcitkara (ineffective).
function: Lifts lower-śāstra initiates into the Śiva course (liṅgoddhāra) without rejecting their prior path.
local_context: A16 (parokṣa) precedes; A17 teaches lower-path lifting; A18 (abhiṣeka) follows.
boundary: Mantra identities (traditional). L1 CONDENSED? No — A17 is 6 verses, full close done.
